ValidationRule.description: #21200- Restrict users from moving an Opportunity from Stage 6 to Stage 5 except Admins #21201- Users with Move Opportunity To stage 5 permission set are bypassed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), '6 - Setup'),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator',
NOT( $Permission.Update_Stage_of_Closed_Opportunities ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to move an Opportunity from Stage 6 to Stage 5. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
